questions.question: A cuboidal water tank is 12 m long, 9 m wide and 7.5 m deep. How many litres of water can it hold?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length (l) = 12 m

Width (w) = 9 m

Depth (h) = 7.5 m

**Formula:**

Volume (V) = l × w × h

**Calculation:**

Volume in cubic meters = 12 × 9 × 7.5 = 810 m³

1 cubic meter = 1000 liters

**Volume in liters = 810 × 1000 = 810,000 liters**

questions.question: Pawan purchases 70 articles for Rs. 16,875 and sells them at a loss equal to the selling price of 5 articles. What will be the selling price of one article?
questions.solution:
Given:

Cost price of 70 articles = Rs. 16875

Loss = 5 × Selling price of 1 article

Formula used:

Loss = Cost price - Selling price

Calculation:

Let the selling price of one article be Rs. x

So according to the question,

5x = 16875 - 70x

⇒ 75x = 16875

⇒ x = 225

∴ Selling price of one article = Rs. 225

**The answer is 225.**

questions.question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 10,000 for 1(1)/(2) years at 20% per annum, interest is payable half - yearly.
questions.solution:

Rate R = 20%

Time period n = 1(1/2) years

Formula Used:

For compounded half yearly

A = p × [1 + (R/2)/100]²ⁿ

Calculation:

⇒ A = 10,000 × [1 + (20/2)/100]² × ³/²

⇒ 10000 × (1.1)³

⇒ 10000 × 1.331

⇒ Rs. 13310

CI = 13310 - 10000 = 3310

**The answer is 3310**

questions.question: A boat can move upstream at 25 km/h and downstream at 35 km/h. What is the speed of the current?
questions.solution:
**Formula used**

The speed of the current = (downstream speed - upstream speed)/2

**Calculation**

Applying the above formula:

The speed of the current = (downstream speed - upstream speed)/2 = (35 - 25)/2

= 5 km/hr

**The answer is 5 km/hr**

questions.question: In an isosceles triangle, if the unequal angle is five times the sum of the equal angles, then each equal angle is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The unequal angle is five times the sum of the equal angles

Concept used:

The sum of the angles of the triangle is 180°.

Calculation:

Let the two equal angles be x.

The unequal angle = 5(x + x) = 10x

⇒ 10x + x + x = 180

⇒ 12x = 180

x = 15

**Each equal angle is 15°**

questions.question: Arun sold his goods at a loss of 10%. If the selling price of the goods had been increased by Rs. 270, there would have been a gain of 8%. What was the cost price (in Rs.) of the goods for Arun?
questions.solution:
Given:

A man sold his goods at a loss of 10%.

Had he sold it for Rs 270 more, he would have gained 8%.

Formula used:

Selling price = cost price (100 + profit)/100

Selling price = cost price (100 – loss)/100

Calculation:

Let the cost price of the watch be x

At a loss of 10%

Selling price = x(100 – 10)/100

⇒ 90x/100

According to the question,

Had he sold it for Rs 270 more, he would have gained 8%.

⇒ (100 + 8)x/100 – 90x/100 = 270

⇒ (108 – 90)x/100 = 270

⇒ 18x = 27000 = 1500

**The answer is 1500**

questions.question: An inlet pipe can fill an empty tank in 51 hours while an outlet pipe drains a completely-filled tank in 76.5 hours. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is empty, in how many hours will the tank get completely filled?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Inlet pipe fills tank in 51 hours.

Outlet pipe empties tank in 76.5 hours.

**Concept Used:**

Rate of filling/emptying tank by pipes when working together = Rate of inlet pipe - Rate of outlet pipe.

**Calculation:**

Rate of inlet pipe: 1/51 tank/hour

Rate of outlet pipe: 1/76.5 tank/hour

Net rate when both pipes are open:

⇒ 1/51 - 1/76.5

⇒ 1.5 - 1 / 76.5

⇒ 0.5 / 76.5 = 1/153

questions.question: At how much per cent above the cost price should a trader mark his goods so that after allowing a discount of 25%, he still gains 5%?
questions.solution:
Given:

Profit = 5%

He offered a discount of 25%

Formula used:

MP/CP = (100 + P)/(100 - D)

Profit% = (selling price - cost price)/cost price × 100

Calculation:

MP/CP = (100 + P)/(100 - D)

MP/CP = 105/75 = 7/5

% over CP = (7 - 5)/5 × 100 = 40%

**The answer is 40%**

questions.question: What is the amount (in Rs.) of debt that will be discharged in 6 equal instalments of Rs. 800 each, if the debt is due in 6 years at 5% per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Time = 6 years

Rate = 5%

**Formula used**

Instalment = [Due amount × 100] / [100t + rt(t – 1) /2]

**Calculation**

Instalment = [Due amount × 100] / [100t + rt(t – 1) /2]

⇒ 800 = [D × 100] / [600 + (5 × 6 × 5) /2]

⇒ 800 = 100D/675

⇒ D = 8 × 675 = 5400

∴ Debt amount = Rs. 5400

**The answer is 5400**

questions.question: If x² - 11x + 1 = 0, what is the value of x⁸ - 14159x⁴ + 11?
questions.solution:
Given:

x² - 11x + 1 = 0

Concept used:

If x + 1/x = p then x² + 1/x² = p² - 2

Calculation:

On dividing x² - 11x + 1 by x we get,

⇒ x - 11 + 1/x = 0

⇒ x + 1/x = 11

⇒ x² + 1/x² = (11)² - 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 121 - 2

x2 + 1/x2 = 119

Squaring both sides

⇒ x4 + 1/x4 = 14161 - 2 = 14159

x8 - 14159x4 + 11

⇒ x⁴(x⁴ - 14159) + 11

⇒ x4(x4 - x4 - 1/x4) + 11

⇒ x4(- 1/x4) + 11

⇒ -1 + 11 = 10

**The answer is 10.**

questions.question: If a + b + c = 16, ab + bc + ac = 81, what is the value of a² + b² + c² ?
questions.solution:
Given:

a + b + c = 16,

ab + bc + ac = 81

Concept used:

(a + b + c)² = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2 × (ab + bc + ac)

Calculation:

a + b + c = 9

⇒ (a + b + c)² = 16²

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2 × (ab + bc + ac) = 256

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2 × (81) = 81

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 = 256 - 162 = 94

**The answer is 94.**

questions.question: Two circles of radii 9 cm and 4 cm, respectively, touch each other externally at point A. PQ is the direct common tangent of those two circles of centres O₁ and O₂, respectively. The length of PQ is equal to:

The radii of both circles are 9 cm and 4 cm

Both circles touch each other at point A externally

PQ is the common tangent of both circles.

Calculations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bac1d32bfade07ef074bcc877b6c79563f80bd2823caba6b424da1595303fb1.png] 

Length of a direct common tangent, when 2 circles are touching externally, 

⇒ √[d² - (R - r)²]

where D is the distance between 2 centres

R and r are 2 radii of circles

Calculation:

Using the formula, we get

⇒ √[132 - (9 - 4)²]

⇒ √144 = 12

∴ The length of PQ = 12 cm.

questions.question:
Simplify the following expression.

(a + b + c)² - (a - b + c)² + 4 ac
questions.solution:
**Formula used**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

**Calculation**

(a + b + c)2 - (a - b + c)2 + 4 ac

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca) - [a2 + b2 + c2 - 2ab - 2bc + 2ca)] + 4ac

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca) - a2 - b2 - c2 + 2ab + 2bc - 2ca + 4ac

⇒ 2ab + 2bc + 2ab + 2bc + 4ac

⇒ 4(ab + bc + ca)

**The answer is 4(ab + bc + ca)**
